visible_blocks_in_order.text: About Carpio Media
Juan Carpio, Founder

Great work feels easy when the people behind it are prepared. Carpio Media brings a calm, hands on approach to every project so clients can feel confident from the first conversation through final delivery.

Founder Juan Carpio brings more than two decades of aviation experience to the work. As a former airline captain and instructor with more than 9,000 flight hours, he built Carpio Media on preparation, communication, precision, and sound judgment. He became an FAA Part 107 certified drone pilot in 2018 and expanded into FPV, photography, video, and real estate media.

That background makes a difference on every production. Whether we are filming a property, creating content for a brand, documenting a construction site, or supporting a broadcast crew, Juan is directly involved in location review, flight planning, piloting, photography, and creative direction.

Carpio Media has supported work for organizations including ABC and ESPN while staying rooted in the clients and neighborhoods that make New York special. We serve Queens, New York City, Long Island, Westchester, New Jersey, and Connecticut with the same focus, care, and professional standards.
The goal is simple. Create visuals that make people stop, look closer, and want to know more about your story, property, or brand.

Carpio Media is proudly based in Forest Hills. The company was inspired by the Forest Hills Youth Athletics sponsor wall, a reminder that strong local businesses give energy back to the community that supports them.
Forest Hills, NY

Based in Forest Hills, Queens, we work with real estate professionals, brands, agencies, production teams, and local organizations that want more than a basic camera angle. visible_blocks_in_order.text: Cinematic Drone Production for Film and Television in NYC

Carpio Media provides cinematic drone production for television, documentaries, commercials, branded films, features, episodic projects, and live broadcast support. Based in Forest Hills, Queens, we work with producers, directors, cinematographers, agencies, location teams, and production companies throughout New York City and the Tri State Area.

Coverage can include establishing shots, location reveals, tracking shots, transitions, moving subject coverage, cityscapes, landscapes, and controlled aerial sequences designed to support the story and visual language of the production.

Production planning considers the shot list, airspace, location restrictions, permits, weather, sun position, crew movement, talent, vehicles, communication, camera requirements, and safe operating areas. Carpio Media can coordinate with the production team so each aerial setup fits the schedule and the needs of the scene.

To request availability, send the production type, location, shoot date, call time, shot list or storyboard, camera and delivery requirements, crew contacts, permit status, and any location restrictions through the Contact page.

visible_blocks_in_order.text: FPV Drone Videography & Cinematic Fly-Throughs in NYC

Carpio Media produces immersive FPV drone video for commercials, branded content, film and television, real estate, hospitality, sports, events, and complex spaces. Based in Forest Hills, Queens, we serve projects throughout New York City, Long Island, Westchester, New Jersey, and Connecticut.

Unlike traditional aerial shots, FPV cameras can follow planned routes through entrances, rooms, corridors, venues, and exterior environments to connect multiple spaces in one continuous-feeling sequence. Depending on the creative and production requirements, FPV systems can support lightweight action cameras or cinema-camera payloads.

Every route is designed around the location, people, obstacles, airspace, permissions, lighting, speed, and safe launch and recovery zones. Pre-production can include a site review, flight-path planning, rehearsals, coordination with talent and crew, and multiple takes.

To request a quote, send the location, whether the route is indoors or outdoors, the concept or visual reference, planned path, preferred date, crew or talent details, required deliverables, deadline, and any property or production restrictions through the Contact page.
